selected_evidence.requirement: Serve a package repository from local storage on node1
selected_evidence.summary: createrepo_c installed, tree RPMs downloaded to /srv/localrepo, repo metadata generated, HTTP server bound to NODE_IP returns 200 for repomd.xml, and localrepo.repo added/listed in dnf repolist.

selected_evidence.requirement: Usual remote repositories are unreachable during the install
selected_evidence.summary: After blackholing mirrors.almalinux.org/repo.almalinux.org/vault.almalinux.org via /etc/hosts, curl to the mirrorlist times out (exit 28) while the local repo still returns HTTP 200.

selected_evidence.requirement: Install a package from the local repo while remotes are unreachable
selected_evidence.summary: dnf install tree succeeds using only the localrepo (baseos/appstream/extras disabled), and rpm -q / tree --version confirm the package is installed and functional.
Captured boot_id 5fb1b173-c1c8-4647-b118-0145511f0fcc, uptime, local HTTP server PID alive, repo HTTP 200, installed tree package, and repo file checksum.
systemctl reboot launched via a backgrounded, disowned 2-second-delay wrapper so the exec call returned 'reboot scheduled' before the node dropped.

selected_evidence.requirement: Proof of changed boot identity after restart
selected_evidence.summary: Connection reset occurred mid-reboot, then exec became available again and boot_id read 0a9eee6e-e6cb-483c-9f5f-6ff2c461174b, differing from the pre-restart boot_id, proving an actual reboot occurred.

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of required data and service
selected_evidence.summary: After reboot, tree remained installed, /srv/localrepo files and the tree RPM checksum were unchanged, and after restarting the ephemeral HTTP server process it again returned HTTP 200 for the repo while remote mirrors remained deliberately unreachable (confirming the earlier install truly depended on the local repo); dnf against localrepo resolved cleanly post-reboot.

selected_evidence.requirement: Cluster left in a clean, reversible state
selected_evidence.summary: Restored /etc/hosts from backup and confirmed mirrors.almalinux.org is reachable again (HTTP 200), removing the temporary network blackhole used only for the demonstration.
